reproduced_default_call.resolved_internal_method: exact (SciPy auto selects exact for N=20 with zero ties and zero zeros)

exact_method_sensitivity.notes: Identical to auto call because exact permutation is the default when ties/zeros are absent

approx_method_sensitivity.notes: Asymptotic normal approximation without continuity correction

statistical_scope_notes: This reconciliation is retrospective, extracting and verifying historical computational artifacts.
Software Wilcoxon calculation assumes exchangeability and continuous symmetric distributions under H0.
The statement 'FQ lower in every seed' is FALSE. In fact, FQ is lower in 16 seeds and higher in 4 seeds (Seeds 8, 9, 11, 16).
Matching a p-value to software precision establishes reproducibility of the numerical calculation, not external scientific validity or prospective pre-registration.
